label: prf:habiro-pochhammer-bridge
title: Proof of habiro pochhammer bridge
html:
Proof. The identity 1 - q^k = 1 - u^{2k} = (1 - u^k)(1 + u^k) is immediate from q = u^2. Applying it to each factor of the Pochhammer product gives

  (q;q)_m = \prod_{k=1}^{m}(1 - q^k)
  = \prod_{k=1}^{m}(1 - u^k)(1 + u^k)
  = (u;u)_m \cdot \prod_{k=1}^{m}(1 + u^k).

Substituting into the numerator:

  \sum_m a_m(u)\,(q;q)_m
  = \sum_m a_m(u)\,(u;u)_m \cdot \prod_{k=1}^{m}(1 + u^k).

Dividing by \sum_m a_m(u)\,(u;u)_m gives the weighted average. \square
heading: Proof
